original_test_intent: Verify the actual installed capacity reported for every Type 7 cache instance, including defined zero/not-installed and extended-size encodings, matches the approved cache population and does not exceed maximum capacity before and after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain the legacy Installed Cache Size word and applicable Installed Cache Size 2, decode granularity/selector and zero semantics per handle/level, compare effective installed bytes with the platform cache map and maximum capacity, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves installed-capacity and zero/not-installed expectations, encoding rules, maximum/enabled relationships and reboot plan. Verification is automatable.
required_inputs: Expected installed capacity or approved not-installed state for every Type 7 handle
Applicable legacy unit/granularity, zero and extended Installed Cache Size 2 selector semantics
Expected Maximum Cache Size and Cache Configuration enabled/socketed relationship
Approved Type 4 cache references and shared-cache topology
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not flush, resize, disable, benchmark or reconfigure caches or firmware.
Preserve raw legacy word, granularity bit, formatted length and extended size; normalized output can hide zero/selector defects.
Interpret zero/not-installed only under the applicable SMBIOS semantics and platform policy; do not treat missing parser output as zero.
Require installed capacity not to exceed effective maximum and reconcile a not-installed value with enabled/socketed configuration and Type 4 references.
Stop on invalid length/selector, impossible relationships, unit ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode effective installed capacity per Type 7 handle, validate zero/extended encoding and maximum/configuration/topology relationships before/after reboot.
Do not change cache state, substitute OS capacity without approved mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve installed/absent baseline, encoding and maximum/configuration relationship rules.
Approve topology/reboot recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses raw unit, zero and extended selector semantics plus handle/level/configuration context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain legacy and extended installed-size fields with handle/level and calculate effective bytes under version/length guards.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Installed Cache Size scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: INSTALLED CACHE POPULATION AND CAPACITY VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode legacy/extended installed-size fields directly, distinguish a defined not-installed value from malformed absence, then validate effective bytes against maximum capacity, cache configuration and Type 4 topology before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 7 systems, including capacities using extended fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, Type 7 length, BIOS, CPU/cache topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Installed Cache Size and Installed Cache Size 2 encodings, Cache Configuration semantics, approved platform topology and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw zero/unit/selector evidence and relational checks while preserving installed-capacity intent.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects not-installed/configuration contradictions and extended-size encoding faults.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS cache enumeration can aggregate or omit caches and is supporting evidence only unless a handle-level mapping is approved.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve zero/not-installed for a socketed but empty cache instance or a specific installed capacity, but must define its relationship to enabled state, maximum size and Type 4 references.
expected_evidence: Approved installed/maximum/configuration map, zero/encoding policy, topology and parser versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 7 table with handle/level, raw legacy/granularity and extended installed-size values plus effective bytes
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict with any authorized not-installed cache rationale
